expertiseSources.summary: Defines decision status, rejected alternatives, consequences, and supersession rather than rewriting accepted history.

exception.rationale: The streamlined workflow preserves accepted decision history, prevents invented acceptance, and distinguishes safely executed setup/examples from traced or unavailable checks. It prohibits speculative destructive setup and dependency installation. These record-integrity and execution boundaries justify a requested safety exception rather than an unsupported average quality improvement; human approval and runtime uplift are not claimed.
